recomputation.rule: value is recomputed from the current period's billing data, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: metric_name's value must resolve to an actual computed figure from the current billing/finance data source — no fabricated figures.

record_spec.source_standard: SaaS unit-economics metric set (CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, Rule of 40) — de facto convention popularized by Bessemer's Cloud reports, no single ratified standards body found (scout-brief gap, stated as assumption); https://www.dualentry.com/blog/saas-unit-economics

use_when.board_condition: a finance review checkpoint occurs AND no finance-unit-economics record exists yet for that period
